lesson.title: 用恒等式解三角方程

en.title: Solving Trigonometric Equations Using Identities
en.description: Complete source questions and worked solutions. In solutions, s = sin u, c = cos u and t = tan u, where u is the current part's angle (such as x, A, B or θ), unless the question explicitly defines a different variable.

concepts.title: 恒等式代换与因式分解
concepts.summary: 先化为一个三角函数的代数方程。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 用 $\sin2x=2\sin x\cos x$、$\cos2x=1-2\sin^2x=2\cos^2x-1$ 代换，再因式分解或用求根公式。

pitfalls: 不要除以可能为零的三角因子；先保留每个零因子分支。

en.title: Substitution and factoring
en.summary: Rewrite as an algebraic equation in one trigonometric function.

method.title: Method
method.body: Substitute $\sin2x=2\sin x\cos x$ or $\cos2x=1-2\sin^2x=2\cos^2x-1$, then factor or use the quadratic formula.

pitfalls: Keep every zero-factor branch before dividing by a trigonometric factor.

concepts.title: 原式禁值与候选解
concepts.summary: 约分或清分母不能改变原式定义域。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先列 $\sin x\ne0$ 或 $\cos x\ne0$ 等限制，再解方程并代回原式；舍去绝对值超过1的正弦或余弦值。

pitfalls: 图像可能掩盖孤立的空点。

en.title: Original restrictions and candidates
en.summary: Cancellation and clearing denominators retain the original domain.

method.title: Method
method.body: Record restrictions such as $\sin x\ne0$ or $\cos x\ne0$, solve, and check the original equation. Reject sine/cosine values outside $[-1,1]$.

pitfalls: A graph can hide isolated holes.

concepts.title: 区间解与一般解
concepts.summary: 列出全部象限及周期，再核对端点。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 弧度的一般解写 $n\in\mathbb Z$；对 $\sin2x=a$ 先解完整的 $2x$ 区间，再除以2。

pitfalls: 角度和弧度不混用，开闭端点按题目保留。

en.title: Interval and general solutions
en.summary: List every quadrant and period, then check endpoints.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use $n\in\mathbb Z$ for general solutions. For $\sin2x=a$, solve over the full interval for $2x$ before dividing by 2.

pitfalls: Keep degrees and radians distinct and respect open/closed endpoints.

concepts.title: 图像核验与错误分析
concepts.summary: 代数确定精确解，图像核对交点与漏解。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 同时画原等式两边或画“左边减右边”，核对零点与原式禁值。

pitfalls: 数值图像不能代替完整的一般解证明。

en.title: Graph checks and error analysis
en.summary: Algebra gives exact solutions; graphs check intersections and omissions.

method.title: Method
method.body: Plot both original sides, or their difference, and compare zeros while retaining excluded inputs.

pitfalls: A numerical graph does not prove a complete general solution.

questions.prompt: 代数解 $0\le x<2\pi$ 上的方程：(a) $\cos2x+1-\cos x=0$；(b) $1-\cos^2x=3\sin x-2$。

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $2\cos^2x-1+1-\cos x=\cos x(2\cos x-1)=0.$ cos x=0给π/2、3π/2；cos x=1/2给π/3、5π/3；原式无禁值。

steps.title: (b) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\sin^2x-3\sin x+2=(\sin x-1)(\sin x-2)=0.$ sin x=2超出值域；sin x=1在指定区间仅给π/2。

en.prompt: Solve algebraically for $0\le x<2\pi$: (a) $\cos2x+1-\cos x=0$; (b) $1-\cos^2x=3\sin x-2$.

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $2\cos^2x-1+1-\cos x=\cos x(2\cos x-1)=0.$ cos x=0 gives π/2 and 3π/2; cos x=1/2 gives π/3 and 5π/3. The original equation has no exclusions.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $\sin^2x-3\sin x+2=(\sin x-1)(\sin x-2)=0.$ Reject sin x=2 as outside the range; sin x=1 gives only π/2 in the interval.

en.label: Example 1

questions.label: 例题 1

questions.prompt: (a) 在 $0^\circ\le x<360^\circ$ 代数解 $\cos^2x=\cot x\sin x$；(b) 用图像核验。

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\sin x\ne0;\quad \cos^2x=\cos x\Rightarrow\cos x(\cos x-1)=0.$ 候选0°、90°、270°；0°使cot未定义，舍去。不可除以cos x，否则漏掉90°、270°。

steps.title: (b) 推导与核对
steps.body: $y_1=\cos^2x,\quad y_2=\cot x\sin x$ 在y2的原定义域作图，仅交于(90°,0)和(270°,0)；0°的表面交点是空点。

en.prompt: (a) Solve $\cos^2x=\cot x\sin x$ algebraically for $0^\circ\le x<360^\circ$. (b) Verify graphically.

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $\sin x\ne0;\quad \cos^2x=\cos x\Rightarrow\cos x(\cos x-1)=0.$ Candidates are 0°, 90°, 270°. Reject 0°, where cot is undefined. Dividing by cos x would lose 90° and 270°.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $y_1=\cos^2x,\quad y_2=\cot x\sin x$ Plot y2 on its original domain. The intersections are (90°,0) and (270°,0); the apparent intersection at 0° is a hole.

en.label: Example 2

questions.label: 例题 2

questions.prompt: 代数解 $\sin2x=\sqrt2\cos x$，给出弧度制一般解。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $2\sin x\cos x-\sqrt2\cos x=\cos x(2\sin x-\sqrt2)=0.$ cos x=0给π/2+πn；sin x=√2/2给π/4+2πn和3π/4+2πn；所有分支均满足原式。

en.prompt: Solve $\sin2x=\sqrt2\cos x$ algebraically. Give the general solution in radians.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $2\sin x\cos x-\sqrt2\cos x=\cos x(2\sin x-\sqrt2)=0.$ cos x=0 gives π/2+πn; sin x=√2/2 gives π/4+2πn and 3π/4+2πn. Every branch satisfies the original equation.

en.label: Example 3

questions.label: 例题 3

questions.prompt: 代数解 $2\sin x=7-3\csc x$，给出弧度制一般解。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $\sin x\ne0;\quad2s=7-3/s\Rightarrow2s^2-7s+3=(2s-1)(s-3)=0.$ s=3超出正弦值域，s=1/2给π/6及5π/6加上整周期；均符合sin x≠0。

en.prompt: Solve $2\sin x=7-3\csc x$ algebraically. Give general solutions in radians.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $\sin x\ne0;\quad2s=7-3/s\Rightarrow2s^2-7s+3=(2s-1)(s-3)=0.$ Reject s=3 as outside the sine range. The value s=1/2 gives π/6 and 5π/6 plus full periods; both satisfy sin x≠0.

en.label: Example 4

questions.label: 例题 4

questions.prompt: 在 $-720^\circ<x\le720^\circ$ 画 $y=\sin2x-\sin x$，作草图并用文字描述。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $f(-x)=-f(x),\quad f(x+360^\circ)=f(x).$ 图像关于原点对称，周期为360°；每周期有四个不同零点，小波峰与大波峰交替。见解析图，左端不含、右端包含。

en.prompt: Graph $y=\sin2x-\sin x$ for $-720^\circ<x\le720^\circ$. Sketch and describe it.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $f(-x)=-f(x),\quad f(x+360^\circ)=f(x).$ The graph has origin symmetry and period 360°. Four distinct zeros occur per period; smaller and larger lobes alternate. The left endpoint is excluded and the right included.

en.label: Investigate 1

questions.label: 探究 1

questions.prompt: 由图确定 $y=\sin2x-\sin x$ 在所有实数上的零点表达式。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $x=0^\circ,60^\circ,180^\circ,300^\circ$ 一个周期内读出这些零点，分别加上360°的整数倍；0°与180°合并为180°n。

en.prompt: Use the graph to give an expression for all real zeros of $y=\sin2x-\sin x$.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $x=0^\circ,60^\circ,180^\circ,300^\circ$ Read these zeros in one period and add integer multiples of 360°; combine 0° and 180° into 180°n.

en.label: Investigate 2

questions.label: 探究 2

questions.prompt: 代数解所有实数上的 $\sin2x-\sin x=0$，并与同学比较答案和方法。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $2\sin x\cos x-\sin x=\sin x(2\cos x-1)=0.$ 所以sin x=0或cos x=1/2，得到下列完整解；可与同学比较分支是否齐全，本页不虚构同学反馈。

en.prompt: Solve $\sin2x-\sin x=0$ algebraically for all real numbers. Compare your answer and method with a classmate.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $2\sin x\cos x-\sin x=\sin x(2\cos x-1)=0.$ Thus sin x=0 or cos x=1/2, giving the complete set below. Compare whether both branches are retained; no classmate response is invented.

en.label: Investigate 3

questions.label: 探究 3

questions.prompt: 反思：图像法与代数法，你更喜欢用哪种方法解 $\sin2x-\sin x=0$？解释。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $\sin x(2\cos x-1)=0$ 示例选择代数法，因为可给出精确的一般解并保证无漏分支；图像可直观核对每周期四个零点。个人偏好可不同。

questions.answer: 示例：代数精确，图像辅助 / Sample: exact algebra with a graph check

en.prompt: Reflect: do you prefer a graphical or algebraic method to solve $\sin2x-\sin x=0$? Explain.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $\sin x(2\cos x-1)=0$ A sample preference is algebra: it gives exact general solutions and accounts for every factor. The graph usefully checks four zeros per period. Personal preferences may differ.

en.answer: Sample: exact algebra with a graph check
en.label: Reflect and Respond 4

questions.label: 反思 4

questions.prompt: 例题1旁注：(a) 为什么选用这种cos2x公式？(b) 为什么sin x=2无解？

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos2x=2\cos^2x-1$ 原式已含cos x，这样全部用cos x表示并得到二次式。

steps.title: (b) 推导与核对
steps.body: $-1\le\sin x\le1$ 实数角的正弦不可能等于2。

questions.answer: (a) $2\cos^2x-1$； (b) 无实数解 / no real solution

en.prompt: Example 1 margin questions: (a) Why choose this form of the cos2x identity? (b) Why has sin x=2 no solution?

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos2x=2\cos^2x-1$ The original equation already contains cos x, so this produces a quadratic in one function.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $-1\le\sin x\le1$ The sine of a real angle cannot equal 2.

en.label: Example 1 margin questions

questions.label: 例题1旁注

questions.prompt: 代数解 $0\le x<2\pi$ 上的方程：(a) $\sin2x-\cos x=0$；(b) $2\cos x+1-\sin^2x=3$。

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos x(2\sin x-1)=0.$ cos x=0给π/2、3π/2，sin x=1/2给π/6、5π/6；原式无禁值。

en.prompt: Solve algebraically for $0\le x<2\pi$: (a) $\sin2x-\cos x=0$; (b) $2\cos x+1-\sin^2x=3$.

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos x(2\sin x-1)=0.$ cos x=0 gives π/2 and 3π/2; sin x=1/2 gives π/6 and 5π/6. There are no exclusions.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $2c+1-(1-c^2)=3\Rightarrow c^2+2c-3=(c+3)(c-1)=0.$ Here c=cos x. Reject c=-3; c=1 gives x=0.

en.label: Your Turn 1

questions.label: 试一试 1

questions.prompt: 例题2旁注：(a) cot x的商恒等式是什么？(b) 为什么不能除以cos x？(c) 图像确认哪些解？

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cot x=\cos x/\sin x,\quad\sin x\ne0.$ 分母限制必须保留。

steps.title: (b) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos x=0$ 这正是90°、270°两个有效解的分支，除以cos会丢失它们。

steps.title: (c) 推导与核对
steps.body: $(90^\circ,0),(270^\circ,0)$ 原式在0°未定义，图像的表面交点不能算解。

questions.answer: (a) $\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$； (b) 可能除以零并漏解 / division by zero loses solutions； (c) $90^\circ,270^\circ$

en.prompt: Example 2 margin questions: (a) What is the quotient identity for cot x? (b) Why not divide by cos x? (c) Which solutions does the graph confirm?

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $\cot x=\cos x/\sin x,\quad\sin x\ne0.$ Retain the denominator restriction.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos x=0$ This is the valid branch x=90°,270°; division would remove it.

steps.title: (c) Derive and check
steps.body: $(90^\circ,0),(270^\circ,0)$ The original equation is undefined at 0°, so the apparent graphical intersection there is invalid.

en.answer: (a) $\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$; (b) Division by zero loses solutions; (c) $90^\circ,270^\circ$
en.label: Example 2 margin questions

questions.label: 例题2旁注

questions.prompt: (a) 在 $0^\circ\le x<360^\circ$ 代数解 $\sin^2x=\frac12\tan x\cos x$；(b) 用图像核验。

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos x\ne0;\quad\sin^2x=\tfrac12\sin x\Rightarrow\sin x(\sin x-\tfrac12)=0.$ sin x=0给0°、180°；sin x=1/2给30°、150°。四个角的cos均非零。

en.prompt: (a) Solve $\sin^2x=\frac12\tan x\cos x$ algebraically for $0^\circ\le x<360^\circ$. (b) Verify graphically.

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos x\ne0;\quad\sin^2x=\tfrac12\sin x\Rightarrow\sin x(\sin x-\tfrac12)=0.$ sin x=0 gives 0° and 180°; sin x=1/2 gives 30° and 150°. All four have nonzero cosine.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $y_1=\sin^2x,\ y_2=\tfrac12\tan x\cos x$ Intersections are (0°,0), (30°,1/4), (150°,1/4), and (180°,0). The holes at 90° and 270° are not solutions.

en.label: Your Turn 2

questions.label: 试一试 2

questions.prompt: 例题3旁注：为什么不能在这里除以cos x？

steps.title: 保留零因子分支
steps.body: $x=\pi/2+\pi n\Rightarrow\cos x=0$。这些角度使原等式两边都为0，是有效解；除以cos x会漏掉它们。

en.prompt: Example 3 margin question: Why is it incorrect to divide by cos x here?

steps.title: Retain the zero-factor branch
steps.body: $x=\pi/2+\pi n\Rightarrow\cos x=0$. Both original sides are zero at these valid solutions. Dividing by cos x would lose them.

en.label: Example 3 margin questions

questions.label: 例题3旁注

questions.prompt: 代数解 $\cos2x=\cos x$，给出弧度制一般解。

en.prompt: Solve $\cos2x=\cos x$ algebraically. Give general solutions in radians.
en.label: Your Turn 3

questions.label: 试一试 3

questions.prompt: 例题4旁注：(a) 为什么两边乘sin x？(b) 为什么sin x=3无解？

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $2s=7-3/s\Rightarrow2s^2=7s-3$ 在s≠0的原定义域中乘s可清除分母，变为二次式。

steps.title: (b) 推导与核对
steps.body: $|\sin x|\le1<3$ 所以该分支没有实数角解。

questions.answer: (a) 清分母，保留 $s\ne0$ / clear denominator with $s\ne0$； (b) 无实数解 / no real solution

en.prompt: Example 4 margin questions: (a) Why multiply by sin x? (b) Why has sin x=3 no solution?

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $2s=7-3/s\Rightarrow2s^2=7s-3$ On the original domain s≠0, multiplying by s clears the denominator and produces a quadratic.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $|\sin x|\le1<3$ Thus that branch has no real-angle solution.

en.answer: (a) Clear denominator with $s\ne0$; (b) No real solution
en.label: Example 4 margin questions

questions.label: 例题4旁注

questions.prompt: 代数解 $3\cos x+2=5\sec x$，给出弧度制一般解。

en.prompt: Solve $3\cos x+2=5\sec x$ algebraically. Give general solutions in radians.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $c\ne0;\quad3c^2+2c-5=(3c+5)(c-1)=0.$ Reject c=-5/3 as outside [-1,1]. For c=1, x=2πn and both original sides equal 5.

en.label: Your Turn 4

questions.label: 试一试 4

lesson.description: 完整原题与逐步解析。解答中以 s = sin u、c = cos u、t = tan u 作代换，u 为当前小问的角（如 x、A、B、θ）；另有明确约定时依该题。

exercises.prompt: 在 $0\le x<2\pi$ 代数解：(a) $\tan^2x-\tan x=0$；(b) $\sin2x-\sin x=0$；(c) $\sin^2x-4\sin x=5$；(d) $\cos2x=\sin x$。

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\tan x(\tan x-1)=0;\ \cos x\ne0.$ tan x=0给0、π；tan x=1给π/4、5π/4，全部符合定义域。

steps.title: (b) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\sin x(2\cos x-1)=0.$ sin x=0给0、π；cos x=1/2给π/3、5π/3。

en.prompt: Solve algebraically for $0\le x<2\pi$: (a) $\tan^2x-\tan x=0$; (b) $\sin2x-\sin x=0$; (c) $\sin^2x-4\sin x=5$; (d) $\cos2x=\sin x$.

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $\tan x(\tan x-1)=0;\ \cos x\ne0.$ tan x=0 gives 0,π; tan x=1 gives π/4,5π/4. All are permitted.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $\sin x(2\cos x-1)=0.$ sin x=0 gives 0,π; cos x=1/2 gives π/3,5π/3.

steps.title: (d) Derive and check
steps.body: $1-2s^2=s\Rightarrow(2s-1)(s+1)=0.$ s=1/2 gives π/6,5π/6; s=-1 gives 3π/2.

exercises.prompt: 在 $0^\circ\le x<360^\circ$ 代数解并用图像核验：(a) $\cos x-\cos2x=0$；(b) $\sin^2x-3\sin x=4$；(c) $\tan x\cos x\sin x-1=0$；(d) $\tan^2x+\sqrt3\tan x=0$。

steps.title: (c) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos x\ne0;\quad\tan x\cos x\sin x-1=\sin^2x-1=0.$ 候选90°、270°均使原式tan未定义，舍去；图上这两个零点为空点。

steps.title: (d) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\tan x(\tan x+\sqrt3)=0;\quad\cos x\ne0.$ tan x=0给0°、180°；tan x=-√3给120°、300°；图像零点一致。

en.prompt: Solve algebraically for $0^\circ\le x<360^\circ$ and verify graphically: (a) $\cos x-\cos2x=0$; (b) $\sin^2x-3\sin x=4$; (c) $\tan x\cos x\sin x-1=0$; (d) $\tan^2x+\sqrt3\tan x=0$.

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $c-(2c^2-1)=0\Rightarrow(2c+1)(c-1)=0.$ c=1 or -1/2; the difference graph has zeros at 0°,120°,240°.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $s^2-3s-4=(s-4)(s+1)=0.$ Reject s=4; s=-1 gives 270°. The difference graph touches the axis only at 270°.

steps.title: (c) Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos x\ne0;\quad\tan x\cos x\sin x-1=\sin^2x-1=0.$ Candidates 90°,270° make the original tangent undefined. Both graphical zeros are holes.

steps.title: (d) Derive and check
steps.body: $\tan x(\tan x+\sqrt3)=0;\quad\cos x\ne0.$ tan x=0 gives 0°,180°; tan x=-√3 gives 120°,300°. These match the graph zeros.

exercises.prompt: 先改写为只含正弦，再在 $0\le x<2\pi$ 代数解：(a) $\cos2x-3\sin x=2$；(b) $2\cos^2x-3\sin x-3=0$；(c) $3\csc x-\sin x=2$；(d) $\tan^2x+2=0$。

steps.title: (b) 推导与核对
steps.body: $2(1-s^2)-3s-3=0\Rightarrow(2s+1)(s+1)=0.$ 两分支分别为s=-1/2和s=-1，得到下列三个解。

steps.title: (c) 推导与核对
steps.body: $s\ne0;\quad3/s-s=2\Rightarrow s^2+2s-3=(s-1)(s+3)=0.$ 舍去s=-3；s=1符合定义域，给π/2。

steps.title: (d) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\frac{s^2}{1-s^2}+2=0,\quad s\ne\pm1\Rightarrow s^2=2.$ 这不在正弦值域；亦可见tan²x≥0，左边至少为2。

en.prompt: Rewrite using sine only, then solve for $0\le x<2\pi$: (a) $\cos2x-3\sin x=2$; (b) $2\cos^2x-3\sin x-3=0$; (c) $3\csc x-\sin x=2$; (d) $\tan^2x+2=0$.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $2(1-s^2)-3s-3=0\Rightarrow(2s+1)(s+1)=0.$ The branches s=-1/2 and s=-1 give the three solutions below.

steps.title: (c) Derive and check
steps.body: $s\ne0;\quad3/s-s=2\Rightarrow s^2+2s-3=(s-1)(s+3)=0.$ Reject s=-3; s=1 is permitted and gives π/2.

steps.title: (d) Derive and check
steps.body: $\frac{s^2}{1-s^2}+2=0,\quad s\ne\pm1\Rightarrow s^2=2.$ This is outside the sine range; equivalently tan²x≥0 makes the original left side at least 2.

exercises.prompt: 在 $-180^\circ\le x<180^\circ$ 代数解 $4\sin^2x=1$。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $\sin x=\pm1/2.$ 正负两分支在指定区间给-150°、-30°、30°、150°，端点均不满足。

en.prompt: Solve $4\sin^2x=1$ algebraically for $-180^\circ\le x<180^\circ$.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $\sin x=\pm1/2.$ Both signs give -150°,-30°,30°,150° in the interval; neither endpoint satisfies the equation.

exercises.prompt: 在 $0\le x<2\pi$ 代数解 $2\tan^2x+3\tan x-2=0$。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $(2t-1)(t+2)=0,\quad t=\tan x,\ \cos x\ne0.$ t=1/2给arctan(1/2)及其加π；t=-2给π-arctan2及2π-arctan2。

en.prompt: Solve $2\tan^2x+3\tan x-2=0$ algebraically for $0\le x<2\pi$.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $(2t-1)(t+2)=0,\quad t=\tan x,\ \cos x\ne0.$ t=1/2 gives arctan(1/2) and that value plus π; t=-2 gives π-arctan2 and 2π-arctan2.

exercises.prompt: 找出Sanesh的错误并完成正确解（角度制）：解 $2\cos^2x=\sqrt3\cos x$。他两边乘 $1/\cos x$ 得 $2\cos x=\sqrt3$，继而 $x=30^\circ+360^\circ n,330^\circ+360^\circ n$。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos x(2\cos x-\sqrt3)=0.$ Sanesh除以cos x，漏掉cos x=0分支。其余分支cos x=√3/2给30°与330°加整周期。

en.prompt: Find Sanesh’s error and complete a correct solution in degrees. Solve $2\cos^2x=\sqrt3\cos x$. He multiplies both sides by $1/\cos x$, obtains $2\cos x=\sqrt3$, then gives $x=30^\circ+360^\circ n,330^\circ+360^\circ n$.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos x(2\cos x-\sqrt3)=0.$ Dividing by cos x lost the cos x=0 branch. The other branch cos x=√3/2 gives 30° and 330° plus full periods.

exercises.prompt: (a) 在 $0\le x<2\pi$ 代数解 $\sin2x=0.5$；(b) 用另一方法解同一方程。

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $0\le2x<4\pi;\quad2x=\pi/6,5\pi/6,13\pi/6,17\pi/6.$ 将四个角分别除以2，保留两圈的解。

steps.title: (b) 推导与核对
steps.body: $2\sin x\cos x=1/2\Rightarrow(\sin x+\cos x)^2=3/2.$ 令sin x+cos x=√2 sin(x+π/4)，得sin(x+π/4)=±√3/2；在π/4≤x+π/4<9π/4取解，减π/4得同样四个角。

en.prompt: (a) Solve $\sin2x=0.5$ algebraically for $0\le x<2\pi$. (b) Solve using a different method.

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $0\le2x<4\pi;\quad2x=\pi/6,5\pi/6,13\pi/6,17\pi/6.$ Divide all four angles by 2, retaining solutions from both turns.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $2\sin x\cos x=1/2\Rightarrow(\sin x+\cos x)^2=3/2.$ Use sin x+cos x=√2 sin(x+π/4). Then sin(x+π/4)=±√3/2. Solve on π/4≤x+π/4<9π/4 and subtract π/4, obtaining the same four angles.

exercises.prompt: 对所有实数代数解 $\sin^2x=\cos^2x+1$，答案用弧度表示。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $1-\cos^2x=\cos^2x+1\Rightarrow2\cos^2x=0.$ 所以cos x=0，所有解为π/2加π的整数倍。

en.prompt: Solve $\sin^2x=\cos^2x+1$ algebraically for all real x. Give answers in radians.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $1-\cos^2x=\cos^2x+1\Rightarrow2\cos^2x=0.$ Thus cos x=0, giving π/2 plus integer multiples of π.

exercises.prompt: 在实数域代数解 $\cos x\sin2x-2\sin x=-2$，答案用弧度表示。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $2\sin x\cos^2x-2\sin x=2\sin x(\cos^2x-1)=-2\sin^3x=-2.$ 得sin³x=1，因此sin x=1，无其他实数分支。

en.prompt: Solve $\cos x\sin2x-2\sin x=-2$ algebraically over the reals. Give answers in radians.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $2\sin x\cos^2x-2\sin x=2\sin x(\cos^2x-1)=-2\sin^3x=-2.$ Hence sin³x=1, so sin x=1 with no other real branch.

exercises.prompt: 方程 $(7\sin x+2)(3\cos x+3)(\tan^2x-2)=0$ 在 $0^\circ<x\le360^\circ$ 有多少个解？解释。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos x\ne0;\quad\sin x=-2/7\ (2),\quad\cos x=-1\ (1),\quad\tan x=\pm\sqrt2\ (4).$ 三组分别有2、1、4个解，互不重叠（tan²=2时sin²=2/3，非4/49；cos=-1时sin=tan=0）。0°、360°均不是零因子。

en.prompt: How many solutions does $(7\sin x+2)(3\cos x+3)(\tan^2x-2)=0$ have for $0^\circ<x\le360^\circ$? Explain.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos x\ne0;\quad\sin x=-2/7\ (2),\quad\cos x=-1\ (1),\quad\tan x=\pm\sqrt2\ (4).$ The branches have 2,1,4 solutions, with no overlap: tan²=2 implies sin²=2/3≠4/49, while cos=-1 implies sin=tan=0. Neither 0° nor 360° is a zero-factor solution.

exercises.prompt: 在 $0\le x<2\pi$ 解 $\sqrt3\cos x\csc x=-2\cos x$。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $\sin x\ne0;\quad\cos x(\sqrt3+2\sin x)=0.$ cos x=0给π/2、3π/2；sin x=-√3/2给4π/3、5π/3；四个角均符合原分母限制。

en.prompt: Solve $\sqrt3\cos x\csc x=-2\cos x$ for $0\le x<2\pi$.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $\sin x\ne0;\quad\cos x(\sqrt3+2\sin x)=0.$ cos x=0 gives π/2,3π/2; sin x=-√3/2 gives 4π/3,5π/3. All four respect the original restriction.

exercises.prompt: 某三角方程的解满足 $\cos x=2/3$ 或 $\cos x=-1/3$。若形式为 $9\cos^2x+B\cos x+C=0$，求B、C。

en.prompt: A trigonometric equation has solutions cos x=2/3 and cos x=-1/3. Find B and C if it has the form $9\cos^2x+B\cos x+C=0$.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $9(c-2/3)(c+1/3)=9c^2-3c-2.$ Comparing coefficients gives B=-3,C=-2.

exercises.prompt: 构造包含sin2x、可用因式分解求解的三角方程，并解之。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $\sin2x=\sin x\Rightarrow\sin x(2\cos x-1)=0.$ 这是一个示例。sin x=0或cos x=1/2，逐分支列一般解；无分母禁值。

exercises.answer: 示例 / Example: $\sin2x=\sin x;\quad x=\pi n,\ \pm\pi/3+2\pi n,\ n\in\mathbb Z$

en.prompt: Create a trigonometric equation containing sin2x that can be solved by factoring. Then solve it.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $\sin2x=\sin x\Rightarrow\sin x(2\cos x-1)=0.$ This is one example. Solve sin x=0 or cos x=1/2 by branches; there are no denominator restrictions.

en.answer: Example: $\sin2x=\sin x;\quad x=\pi n,\ \pm\pi/3+2\pi n,\ n\in\mathbb Z$

exercises.prompt: 代数解 $\sin2x=2\cos x\cos2x$，给出弧度制一般解。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $2\cos x(\sin x-\cos2x)=0\Rightarrow\cos x=0\ \text{or}\ 2s^2+s-1=(2s-1)(s+1)=0.$ cos x=0给π/2+πn；s=1/2给π/6、5π/6加整周期；s=-1已包含在cos x=0分支中。

en.prompt: Solve $\sin2x=2\cos x\cos2x$ algebraically. Give the general solution in radians.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $2\cos x(\sin x-\cos2x)=0\Rightarrow\cos x=0\ \text{or}\ 2s^2+s-1=(2s-1)(s+1)=0.$ cos x=0 gives π/2+πn. The branch s=1/2 gives π/6 and 5π/6 plus full periods. The branch s=-1 is already included in cos x=0.

exercises.prompt: 代数确定 $\cos2x\cos x-\sin2x\sin x=0$ 在 $-360^\circ<x\le360^\circ$ 的解的个数。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos3x=0\Rightarrow3x=90^\circ+180^\circ n\Rightarrow x=30^\circ+60^\circ n.$ -360<30+60n≤360给整数n=-6,-5,…,5，共12个解；端点都不是解。

en.prompt: Determine algebraically how many solutions $\cos2x\cos x-\sin2x\sin x=0$ has for $-360^\circ<x\le360^\circ$.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos3x=0\Rightarrow3x=90^\circ+180^\circ n\Rightarrow x=30^\circ+60^\circ n.$ The inequality -360<30+60n≤360 gives n=-6,-5,…,5: twelve solutions. Neither endpoint is a solution.

exercises.prompt: 代数解 $\sec x+\tan^2x-3\cos x=2$，给出弧度制一般解。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $c\ne0;\quad1/c+1/c^2-1-3c=2\Rightarrow3c^3+3c^2-c-1=(c+1)(3c^2-1)=0.$ 所以c=-1或c=±1/√3，均非零；令α=arccos(1/√3)，正负余弦分支可合并为±α+πn，另加π+2πn。

en.prompt: Solve $\sec x+\tan^2x-3\cos x=2$ algebraically. Give the general solution in radians.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $c\ne0;\quad1/c+1/c^2-1-3c=2\Rightarrow3c^3+3c^2-c-1=(c+1)(3c^2-1)=0.$ Thus c=-1 or c=±1/√3, all nonzero. Let α=arccos(1/√3). Combine the positive/negative cosine branches as ±α+πn, together with π+2πn.

exercises.prompt: 代数解 $4\sin^2x=3\tan^2x-1$，给出弧度制一般解。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos x\ne0;\quad4s^2(1-s^2)=3s^2-(1-s^2)\Rightarrow4s^4=1\Rightarrow s^2=1/2.$ 所有四个象限的|sin x|=√2/2均符合cos≠0；原式两边均为2。

en.prompt: Solve $4\sin^2x=3\tan^2x-1$ algebraically. Give the general solution in radians.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos x\ne0;\quad4s^2(1-s^2)=3s^2-(1-s^2)\Rightarrow4s^4=1\Rightarrow s^2=1/2.$ All four quadrants with |sin x|=√2/2 have cos≠0. Both original sides equal 2.

exercises.prompt: 在 $-\pi\le x\le\pi$ 代数解 $\frac{1-\sin^2x-2\cos x}{\cos^2x-\cos x-2}=-\frac13$。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $c^2-c-2=(c-2)(c+1)\ne0;\quad\frac{c(c-2)}{(c-2)(c+1)}=-1/3\Rightarrow4c=-1.$ 实数角不可能c=2，但c=-1必须排除（±π）。c=-1/4满足原式定义域，在区间给正负arccos(-1/4)。

en.prompt: Solve $\frac{1-\sin^2x-2\cos x}{\cos^2x-\cos x-2}=-\frac13$ algebraically for $-\pi\le x\le\pi$.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $c^2-c-2=(c-2)(c+1)\ne0;\quad\frac{c(c-2)}{(c-2)(c+1)}=-1/3\Rightarrow4c=-1.$ The value c=2 is impossible for a real angle, but c=-1 excludes ±π. The value c=-1/4 is permitted and yields the two angles ±arccos(-1/4).

exercises.prompt: 求 $4(16^{\cos^2x})=2^{6\cos x}$ 的弧度制一般解。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $2^{2+4c^2}=2^{6c}\Rightarrow4c^2-6c+2=2(2c-1)(c-1)=0.$ 底数2>0且不等于1，可令指数相等；c=1/2或1均在值域。

en.prompt: Find the general solution in radians of $4(16^{\cos^2x})=2^{6\cos x}$.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $2^{2+4c^2}=2^{6c}\Rightarrow4c^2-6c+2=2(2c-1)(c-1)=0.$ Since base 2 is positive and unequal to 1, equate exponents. Both c=1/2 and c=1 are in range.

exercises.prompt: 对某些角α、β，有 $\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\beta=m^2$、$\cos^2\alpha+\sin^2\beta=m$。求m的可能值。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $m^2+m=2\Rightarrow(m+2)(m-1)=0.$ 平方和非负，第二式使m≥0，排除-2。m=1确实可取，例如α=β=0，两式均成立。

en.prompt: For some angles α and β, $\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\beta=m^2$ and $\cos^2\alpha+\sin^2\beta=m$. Find the possible values of m.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $m^2+m=2\Rightarrow(m+2)(m-1)=0.$ The second sum of squares gives m≥0, excluding -2. The value m=1 is attainable, for example α=β=0 satisfies both equations.

exercises.prompt: 对于 $\sin x-\cos2x=0$：(a) 选哪个恒等式化为单一三角函数？(b) 如何因式分解求解？(c) 求 $0^\circ\le x<360^\circ$ 的解；(d) 图像核验。

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos2x=1-2\sin^2x$ 使方程只含sin x。

steps.title: (c) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\sin x=1/2\Rightarrow x=30^\circ,150^\circ;\quad\sin x=-1\Rightarrow x=270^\circ.$ 原式没有禁值，三个角均保留。

steps.title: (d) 推导与核对
steps.body: $y=\sin x-\cos2x$ 差函数在30°、150°穿过横轴，在270°接触横轴；全部符合代数结果。

en.prompt: For $\sin x-\cos2x=0$: (a) Which identity gives one trigonometric function? (b) How can factoring solve it? (c) Solve for $0^\circ\le x<360^\circ$. (d) Verify graphically.

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos2x=1-2\sin^2x$ This leaves only sin x.

steps.title: (c) Derive and check
steps.body: $\sin x=1/2\Rightarrow x=30^\circ,150^\circ;\quad\sin x=-1\Rightarrow x=270^\circ.$ There are no original restrictions, so retain all three.

steps.title: (d) Derive and check
steps.body: $y=\sin x-\cos2x$ The difference crosses the axis at 30°,150° and touches it at 270°, matching all algebraic solutions.

exercises.prompt: 对于 $3\cos^2x+\cos x-1=0$：(a) 为什么左边不能因式分解？(b) 用求根公式解；(c) 求 $0^\circ\le x<720^\circ$ 的解。

steps.title: (a) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\Delta=1^2-4(3)(-1)=13.$ 判别式13不是有理数平方，因此不能用有理系数分成一次因子；实数系数下仍能分解。教材“不能分解”应按有理系数理解。

steps.title: (b) 推导与核对
steps.body: $\cos x=c_\pm=\frac{-1\pm\sqrt{13}}6.$ 两个根约为0.434259和-0.767592，均在[-1,1]；令a=arccos(c+)与b=arccos(c-)，用角度制。

steps.title: (c) 推导与核对
steps.body: $a=\arccos(c_+),\ b=\arccos(c_-).$ 第一圈先取a、b、360°−b、360°−a，再给这四个角各加360°得到第二圈，共8解。

exercises.answer: (a) 无有理一次因式 / no rational linear factors； (b) $x=\pm\arccos(c_+)+360^\circ n,\ \pm\arccos(c_-)+360^\circ n$； (c) $a,b,360^\circ-b,360^\circ-a,360^\circ+a,360^\circ+b,720^\circ-b,720^\circ-a$

en.prompt: For $3\cos^2x+\cos x-1=0$: (a) Why is the left side not factorable? (b) Solve using the quadratic formula. (c) Solve for $0^\circ\le x<720^\circ$.

steps.title: (a) Derive and check
steps.body: $\Delta=1^2-4(3)(-1)=13.$ The discriminant 13 is not a rational square, so rational linear factoring is unavailable. Real linear factors do exist; interpret the textbook wording as rational factoring.

steps.title: (b) Derive and check
steps.body: $\cos x=c_\pm=\frac{-1\pm\sqrt{13}}6.$ The two roots are about 0.434259 and -0.767592, both in [-1,1]. Let a=arccos(c+) and b=arccos(c-), measured in degrees.

steps.title: (c) Derive and check
steps.body: $a=\arccos(c_+),\ b=\arccos(c_-).$ Take a,b,360°-b,360°-a in the first turn, and add 360° to each for the second turn: eight solutions.

en.answer: (a) No rational linear factors; (b) $x=\pm\arccos(c_+)+360^\circ n,\ \pm\arccos(c_-)+360^\circ n$; (c) $a,b,360^\circ-b,360^\circ-a,360^\circ+a,360^\circ+b,720^\circ-b,720^\circ-a$

exercises.prompt: 用正弦倍角恒等式构造一个非恒等式方程，解方程并解释为什么不是恒等式。

steps.title: 推导与核对
steps.body: $\sin2x=0\Rightarrow2\sin x\cos x=0\Rightarrow x=(\pi/2)n.$ 这是一个有效示例。在x=π/4时左边为1而右边为0，所以并非所有角度都成立。

exercises.answer: 示例 / Example: $\sin2x=0,\ x=(\pi/2)n,\ n\in\mathbb Z$

en.prompt: Use the sine double-angle identity to create an equation that is not an identity. Solve it and explain why it is not an identity.

steps.title: Derive and check
steps.body: $\sin2x=0\Rightarrow2\sin x\cos x=0\Rightarrow x=(\pi/2)n.$ This is a valid example. At x=π/4, the left side is 1 and the right side 0, so it does not hold for every angle.
